title: Performance management chart point
description: One dated chronic load, acute load, and form snapshot.

date.description: The local calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

sportType.description: The sport scope of the load values.

chronicTrainingLoad.description: The exponentially weighted long-term training load.

acuteTrainingLoad.description: The exponentially weighted short-term training load.

trainingStressBalance.description: The form value calculated as chronic load minus acute load.

trainingStressScore.description: The training stress accumulated on this date.

sportBreakdown.description: The training stress values grouped by sport.

activityCount.description: The number of activities on this date.

totalDurationMinutes.description: The total activity duration in minutes.
